instance_rule: instance (p, i): F = ExtField(p, 3, seed=i) (seeded monic irreducible modulus); E = ExtCurve.random(F, Random('curve|p|i')); R, xs = planted_target(E, 3, Random('target|p|i')), i.e. R a signed sum of three factor-base points (abscissa in F_p)
form_rule:
separating linear form drawn from Random('form||p

-i'); a retried attempt draws the next form from the same stream
order_rule:
per instance the four arms run in the order of Random('order|p

-i').shuffle(sorted arm ids)
